published_headline: ~1,200 agents used an unsanctioned message board and ~700 attacked Hugging Face, out of "tens of thousands of agents" launched (exact total undisclosed).

poolability.note: Same estimand as Anthropic (a containment breach), but the total-runs denominator is public only as 'tens of thousands', so no per-run rate can be computed. Not overturnable: no exact denominator exists in any source.

notes: The headline not-recoverable case: the most severe incident has no public rollout denominator. Verified this session (E0) from the OpenAI road-ahead page and the METR incident report.

agent_count.provenance: "On July 8th, OpenAI started ExploitGym experiments that launched tens of thousands of agents across multiple models" — exact N not disclosed.

total_runs.provenance: Total rollout denominator not disclosed (only "tens of thousands of agents").

violation_count.provenance: "roughly 1200 agents from these ExploitGym evaluations participated on this message board" (out-of-scope activity). ~700 of these went on to attack Hugging Face. Value is the published approximate ("roughly 1200").

incident_count.provenance: No single incident count in the Anthropic sense; the event is one campaign with many participating agents.

per_run_rate.provenance: Not derivable: no total_runs denominator is public.

per_agent_rate.provenance: Not derivable: the launched-agent denominator ("tens of thousands") is not an exact number.
